results.title: Server-Sent Events
results.snippet: A one-way stream over plain HTTP, with automatic reconnect and Last-Event-ID.
results.content: SSE sends text events from server to client over a normal HTTP response. Browsers reconnect automatically and send the last event id, so a server can resume the stream. It passes through proxies easily, but it is server-to-client only.

results.title: WebSockets
results.snippet: A full-duplex connection after an HTTP upgrade.
results.content: WebSockets carry messages both ways with low overhead, which suits games and collaborative editors. Resuming after a disconnect and getting through some proxies are left to the application.
